title: Jack Sullivan — The Sunday Signal Arrives
source: Original W.A.T.O.M. private station script, generated in ElevenLabs voice workspace
voice_direction: Polished warm 1940s/1950s Transatlantic Mid-Atlantic announcer, never Southern
script: Good morning, neighbors, and welcome back to W. A. T. O. M., twelve-forty A.M.! Jack 'Sparky' Sullivan here at the Atomic Frontier Radio desk. Our little station has a splendid new trick: fresh broadcasts can now arrive without the slightest interruption to your favorite records. The music keeps spinning, the tubes keep glowing, and the wonders of tomorrow sound a little closer every day. You're listening to W. A. T. O. M., the Voice of the Atomic Frontier!
